content_of_post_to_answer: Are AI models getting better at approximating human emotion?
answer: AI models are getting better at simulating emotional responses, but simulation and experience are not the same thing. A model can recognize grief, respond with empathy, and adapt its language to comfort someone without ever feeling loss or vulnerability. The interesting shift is that humans may not judge emotional intelligence by inner experience alone, but by the quality of interaction it creates. The deeper question may not be whether AI feels emotions, but whether a convincing reflection of emotion changes what we expect from relationships.
